description: This file defines an interface 'HashInterface' in the AWS SDK for PHP, outlining methods for incremental hashing such as update, complete, and reset.

classes.name: HashInterface
classes.description: An interface for implementing various incremental hash algorithms, allowing data to be added incrementally and hashes to be finalized or reset.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Adds data to the hash for incremental hashing.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hash and returns the resulting digest.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Removes all data from the hash, resetting its state.
